title: grn.posted.v1
description: Emitted once per accepted Goods Receipt line by procurement-service (src/procurement/procurement.service.ts) and consumed by ledger-service (internal/kafka/consumer.go) to post a Dr Raw Material Inventory / Cr Accounts Payable journal entry. See docs/SDD.md §3.B.

event_id.description: == grn_line_id. Doubles as journal_entries.source_event_id for idempotent posting.

accepted_value.description: accepted_qty * unit_cost — matches posting_rules.amount_expression for this event_type in the dev seed.
